name: Heartfire Sentinel
body:
Heartfire Sentinels are driven by an unwavering commitment to protect and defend their loved ones.

Be they children, parents, siblings, spouses, or some other person the sentinel has taken a liking to.

Role: Heartfire Sentinels are fierce warriors, embodying the divine essence of battle and protection. They excel in close-quarters combat, leading the charge and inspiring allies with their unwavering dedication to warfare and the defense of their loved ones.

Alignment: All Heartfire Sentinels are infused with uncontrollable emotions and an overwhelming desire to protect their loved ones. They can be irrational and extreme in their efforts, willing to violate norms and laws. As such, Heartfire Sentinels are always of a chaotic alignment.

Hit Die: d10.

Requirements

To qualify to become a Heartfire Sentinels, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Alignment: Any chaotic.
Base Attack Bonus: +8.
Skills: Intimidate 8 ranks, Knowledge (war) 8 ranks.
Special: Lay on Hands and Warrior’s Ward special abilities.
Class Skills

The Heartfire Sentinel’s class skills are Craft (Int), Handle Animal (Cha), Heal (Wis), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (religion) (Int), Knowledge (war) (Int), Profession (Wis), Ride (Dex), Sense Motive (Wis), and Spellcraft (Int).

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier

Table 4: The Heartfire Sentinel
Level	Base Attack	Fort	Ref	Will	Special	Spells per Day
1	+1	+1	+0	+1	Unyielding protector	+1 level of existing class
2	+2	+1	+1	+1	Ignite emotions	+1 level of existing class
3	+3	+2	+1	+2	Mercy	+1 level of existing class
4	+4	+2	+1	+2	Spellsword	+1 level of existing class
5	+5	+3	+2	+3	Love sickness	+1 level of existing class
Class Features

All of the following are class features of the Heartfire Sentinel advanced class.

Spells per Day: At the indicated levels, a Heartfire Sentinel gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in a spellcasting class she belonged to before adding this advanced class. She does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if she is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If a character had more than one spellcasting class before becoming a Heartfire Sentinel, she must decide to which class she adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

Unyielding Protector (Ex)

At 1st level, once per round, when a creature within the Heartfire Sentinel’s reach makes an attack against an ally adjacent to the Heartfire Sentinel, the Heartfire Sentinel can make an attack of opportunity against that creature.

Ignite Emotions (Sp)

Beginning at 2nd level, a Heartfire Sentinel can cast the following spells as spell-like abilities, each usable once per day: mass castigate, crushing despair, joyful rapture, and overwhelming grief. The sentinel’s caster level for these spells is equal to her total character level. The saving throws for these spells are equal to 10 + half the sentinel’s total character level + the sentinel’s Charisma modifier.

Mercy (Su)

At 3rd level, a Heartfire Sentinel can select one mercy. Each mercy adds an effect to her Lay on Hands ability. Whenever the Heartfire Sentinel uses Lay on Hands to heal damage to one target, the target also receives the additional effects from all of the mercies possessed by the Heartfire Sentinel. A mercy can remove a condition caused by a curse, disease, or poison without curing the affliction. Such conditions return after 1 hour unless the mercy actually removes the affliction that causes the condition.

The Heartfire Sentinel can select from the following mercies.

Dazed: The target is no longer dazed.
Deceived: The target can immediately attempt a new saving throw to disbelieve any ongoing illusions that it failed to disbelieve within the last minute.
Diseased: The sentinel’s lay on hands ability also acts as remove disease, using the sentinel’s level as the caster level.
Enfeebled: The sentinel dispels any magical effects that are reducing one of the target’s ability scores (sentinel’s choice).
Fatigued: The target is no longer fatigued.
Haunted: The sentinel’s Lay on Hands also acts as protection from evil, but only for the purpose of allowing a new saving throw against enchantment (charm) and enchantment (compulsion) effects, making the target immune to any attempts to possess or exercise mental control over the target, or preventing a life force from controlling the target (all as described in the second effect of protection from evil). Use the sentinel’s level as the caster level.
Riled: The sentinel’s Lay on Hands also acts as calm emotions, but only for the purpose of suppressing morale bonuses (such as from the rage spell) and emotion effects that aren’t fear effects. Use the sentinel’s level as the caster level.
Shaken: The target is no longer shaken.
Sickened: The target is no longer sickened.
Staggered: The target is no longer staggered, unless the target is at exactly 0 hit points.
Targeted: The sentinel’s Lay on Hands also acts as sanctuary, using the champion’s level as the caster level. The saving throw DC to negate this effect is equal to 10 + 1/2 the sentinel’s level + the sentinel’s Charisma modifier.
Spellsword (Su)

At 4th level, when the Heartfire Sentinel hits a creature with a melee weapon attack, she can cast a spell as a swift action. Instead of the spell creating its normal effects, the Heartfire Sentinel deals an additional 1d8 points of damage per level of the spell cast instead. For the purpose of overcoming damage reduction, this damage is considered magic and chaotic-aligned (anarchic).

Love Sickness (Su)

At 5th level, a Heartfire Sentinel gains the iconic power of Aphrodite Areia.

Once per day, she can cast a specific type of geas/quest spell on one creature she can see within 50 feet. This spell fills the target with an overwhelming romantic desire for a forbidden creature. The desired creature may be forbidden by social norms, laws, physical barriers, or some other restriction. This effect is otherwise the same as the spell.
